notes: Positions s4_f2 to s4_f4: the text puts the quarries, three caves and cisterns in the area 'extending between the lime pit and the farm buildings', and the lime pit is 80 m east. They are therefore coded E from the site, with no distance given. Fig. 2 (north arrow, 0-20 m scale) agrees once read by its north arrow, which points to the upper right of the page (about 58 deg clockwise from page-up): the 'tombs' and both 'water cistern' labels lie roughly ENE to E of the buildings. The unit's recorded point (map ref 17790/13940, 100 m precision) cannot be placed on Fig. 2, so no plan position is used. Fig. 1 has no north arrow and no scale bar. s4_f5 is the article's summary of installations around the farmhouses, which include the Area A farmhouse 'north of it' (map ref 17770/13960). It may overlap s4_f4 and cannot be tied to either farmhouse, so its position is none. Not coded: the winepress collecting vat in Room L1 (1.60 x 1.63 m; a vat), the trough and the quarries. Area A's own description is not in the excerpts. E367 (Kh. et-Tinat) is the same site, not a separate one, so no grid position is used.
